title: The Endless Room
author: P. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Sterling, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
